definition: Autonomic networking follows the concept of Autonomic Computing, an initiative started by IBM in 2001.
details: Its ultimate aim is to create self-managing networks to overcome the rapidly growing complexity of the Internet and other networks and to enable their further growth, far beyond the size of today.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. And that shape of the machine — Autonomic networking — is what makes everything else possible.
